topic: 地点、方向与正在发生的事
grammarFocus: there is / are；地点介词；现在进行时；祈使句入门。
title: At the Library
instructions: 这是一个模拟的英语听力练习，适合A1水平学习者。听录音，回答8个问题。所有问题都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须与录音中的原词完全一致，且不超过字数限制。请仔细听录音中的对话和指示。
transcript: A: Excuse me, where is the library? B: It is next to the bank. A: Thank you. B: You're welcome. A: Is there a quiet room? B: Yes, there is. It is on the second floor. A: Are there computers? B: Yes, there are. They are in the quiet room. A: Good. What are you doing? B: I am reading a book. A: Please be quiet. B: Sorry. A: Where is the cafe? B: It is behind the library. A: Thanks. B: You're welcome.

questions.explanation: 录音中B说“It is next to the bank.”，意思是图书馆在银行旁边。
questions.evidence: It is next to the bank.

questions.explanation: 录音中B说“Yes, there is.”，表示有安静的房间。

questions.prompt: 安静的房间在______楼。（填一个词）
questions.explanation: 录音中B说“It is on the second floor.”，所以填second。
questions.evidence: It is on the second floor.

questions.explanation: 录音中B说“They are in the quiet room.”，意思是电脑在安静的房间。
questions.evidence: They are in the quiet room.

questions.explanation: 录音中B说“I am reading a book.”，意思是B正在读书。
录音中A说“Please be quiet.”，意思是A让B安静。

questions.prompt: 咖啡馆在图书馆______。（填一个词）
questions.explanation: 录音中B说“It is behind the library.”，所以填behind。
录音中B说“It is next to the bank.”，意思是图书馆在银行旁边，所以图书馆旁边是银行。
questions.evidence: It is next to the bank.

vocabulary.example: It is next to the bank.
It is on the second floor.

grammar.title: There is / There are; 地点介词; 现在进行时; 祈使句
grammar.explanation: 我们用“There is”表示有一个东西，用“There are”表示有多个东西。地点介词如“next to”（在旁边）、“behind”（在后面）、“on”（在……上面）用来描述位置。现在进行时表示正在发生的动作，结构是“am/is/are + 动词-ing”。祈使句用来给出指示，比如“Please be quiet.”。
grammar.example: There is a quiet room. It is on the second floor. I am reading a book. Please be quiet.

options: There is a book on the desk.
There are a book on the desk.
There is books on the desk.
answers: There is a book on the desk.

options: The cat is under the table.
The cat is on the table.
The cat is in the table.
answers: The cat is under the table.
questions.explanation: “under”表示在……下面，符合图片或常识。
现在进行时的结构是“is + 动词-ing”，所以“She is reading a book.”正确。
祈使句以动词原形开头，所以“Please sit down.”正确。
